name: @zena-lang/registry
description: The Zena App View, the package manager's service, written in Zena: its registry methods, its site, and the service that runs it with its PDS

test:emulator.#command: The store conformance tests, and the service on Firestore, against the Firestore emulator. Not part of `test`: the emulator needs the flake's `emulators` shell (firebase-tools and Java, about 2 GB), which the root `emulators:start` service enters itself.

demo.#command: An App View for pkg.test on this machine, with a stand-in PLC directory and a resolver for its handles, to try `zena pkg login`, `zena pkg publish` and `zena pkg add` against: dev/demo.zena prints how, and writes the variables to .zena/demo/env.sh. Runs until stopped.
demo.command: cd ../.. && mkdir -p .zena/demo && DEMO_REPO=$PWD APP_VIEW_WEB_DIR=${APP_VIEW_WEB_DIR:-/web} ./target/release/zena-cli run --allow-spawn --dir packages/pds-web/out::/web --dir .zena/demo::/demo packages/registry/dev/demo.zena

demo:publish.#command: The demo, with the scope zena-lang, owned by its maintainer, and the packages DEMO_PUBLISH names (by default packages/wit-parser, packages/markdown, packages/workflow and packages/zebra, in that order) published in it with `zena pkg login` and `zena pkg publish`, each from a copy in .zena/demo/packages. Runs until stopped.
demo:publish.command: cd ../.. && mkdir -p .zena/demo && DEMO_REPO=$PWD DEMO_SCOPES=${DEMO_SCOPES:-zena-lang=did:plc:maintainermaintainermain} DEMO_PUBLISH="${DEMO_PUBLISH:-packages/wit-parser packages/markdown packages/workflow packages/zebra}" APP_VIEW_WEB_DIR=${APP_VIEW_WEB_DIR:-/web} ./target/release/zena-cli run --allow-spawn --dir packages/pds-web/out::/web --dir .zena/demo::/demo packages/registry/dev/demo.zena

build:server.#command: Compiles the two servers the image runs: src/main.zena, the App View, into deploy/registry.wasm, and padstone's packages/pds/src/main.zena into deploy/pds.wasm.
build:server.command: cd ../.. && ./target/release/zena-cli build packages/registry/src/main.zena -o packages/registry/deploy/registry.wasm && ./target/release/zena-cli build packages/pds/src/main.zena -o packages/registry/deploy/pds.wasm

stage:docker.#command: Stages a Linux x86_64 zena-run into deploy/ for the image, with the website's resolving and patching (deploy/stage-docker.js).

stage:web.#command: Copies the web app's build (packages/pds-web) into deploy/web for the image, which serves it as APP_VIEW_WEB_DIR.

docker:build.#command: Builds the image locally, for those with Docker; deploy:image builds it with Cloud Build instead.
docker:build.command: docker build --platform linux/amd64 --file deploy/Dockerfile --tag zena-pkg deploy

deploy:setup.#command: One time, and idempotent: the Google Cloud resources of the environment PDS_ENV (staging by default), in the project its settings in deploy/environments/ name. See deploy/setup.sh. No files, so it always runs: re-running is the fix when a step failed.

deploy:image.#command: Builds the image with Cloud Build from deploy/, and pushes it. The same image serves both environments.
deploy:image.command: bash -c 'source deploy/env.sh > /dev/null && gcloud builds submit --project "$PROJECT" --config deploy/cloudbuild.yaml --substitutions _IMAGE="$IMAGE" deploy'

deploy.#command: Deploys the image to the environment PDS_ENV (staging by default), and checks that it answers. See deploy/deploy.sh.

deploy:domain.#command: Once, after the first deploy: maps the environment's domain to its service and writes the records it needs. Needs gcloud's beta component. See deploy/domain.sh.

deploy:alerts.#command: Once both names answer: uptime checks of both, alerts by email to ZENA_ALERT_EMAIL, and with ZENA_MONTHLY_BUDGET a budget on the project. Needs gcloud's beta component. See deploy/alerts.sh.

deploy:smoke.#command: After every deploy: checks the environment as its clients see it, and publishes and withdraws a version of the canary package as an automation account (dev/smoke.zena). `deploy/smoke.sh setup` makes the canary once. See deploy/smoke.sh.
